{{Quote|Excuse me, is this platform B?''"<br />"''Uh, platform B...|This handmaiden speaking with a B1 battle droid|<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" />}}
This '''handmaiden''' was present on a [[Unidentified Raxus Secundus spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Raxus Secundus/Legends|Raxus Secundus]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the events of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
She and [[Unidentified Handmaiden 2|another handmaiden]] worked for [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|Mina Bonteri]] and helped [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] get past the droid controls by distracting the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|droid's]] attention. She was later seen traveling with Bonteri to [[Bonteri house/Legends|her house]].<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" />
